title: Among users located in the United Kingdom who have at least one post with 1
question: Among users located in the United Kingdom who have at least one post with 1000 or more views, find those who received more than 5 negative comments (score < 60) across all their posts. Return their display names and the total count of such negative comments.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055" AS display_name, COUNT(T3."XCL_005") AS negative_comment_count
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
INNER JOIN comments AS T3 ON T2."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_006"
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND T2."XCL_030" >= 1000
  AND T3."XCL_007" < 60
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052", T1."XCL_055"
HAVING COUNT(T3."XCL_005") > 5

measures.eligibility_application: Comments are counted only when their post is owned by a UK user and the post has XCL_030 >= 1000; the comment itself must have XCL_007 < 60.
measures.multiplicity_argument: Each comment row is joined to exactly one post and one user via the ownership chain, so counting comment rows at user grain does not duplicate comments.
